name: Namatame Miki
source:
She has a calm, and cool-headed personality with excellent proportions. She is also quite intelligent, and her attitude of always responding to others with sound arguments does not make a very good impression on others. 

She herself does not actively try to interact with others, and in particular, she blatantly ignores men.

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf003/index.html]official site[/url]]
